name: NASA TR R-100 config 99 (parabolic afterbody, fins excluded)
_notes: Stoney (1961), NASA TR R-100, config 99 data sheet, PDF page 116. d = 1.50 in = 0.0381 m; l_N/d = 7.13 full parabola; CURVED (parabolic) afterbody l_A/d = 5, r_b/R = 0.7; no midbody; NO fins.

Curved afterbody: transition shape parabolic, shapeParameter 1, foreRadius R, aftRadius r_b, so r(x) = R - (R - r_b)(x/L)^2: tangent to the cylinder at the joint, with a base slope twice the inscribed cone's, which is the report's curved-afterbody definition (geometry check: docs/research/Boat-tails/fig10-app/README.md).
Tabulated base angle 3.42 deg; the full parabola through these radii and length gives 3.43 deg.
Used for the cdDelta increment against the same-length cylinder (config 98). Polished finish and 1 mm wall are fixture assumptions.
